published_prior_art.cite: BacryMuzy2016 uses full second-order functions; Koyama2025 and Kirchner2016 give fixed-bin/small-mesh approximations rather than this exact two-lag inverse.
Hawkes1971Spectra and BacryMuzy2016 retain first-order intensity; AchabBacryGaiffasMastromatteoMuzy2017 uses richer integrated cumulants.
CheyssonLang2022 supplies binned-count asymptotics, but not a random-image restricted-logarithm inverse.
WangXieCuozzoMakXie2020 and WangKolarShojaie2025 provide exact-event-time network inference, not this binned inverse.
No inspected paper establishes the stated fixed-bin one-lag injectivity locus; the survey is presently too thin.
Existing Hawkes confidence work and general nonregular-inference literature are relevant, but no inspected paper settles this exact frontier.

novelty_flags.one_line: Its flagship framing names only BacryMuzy2016 and EtesamiZhangSinghalKiyavash2016; add at least ShlomovichCohenAdamsPatel2022 and the fixed-bin/aggregation literature as evaluated candidates.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed one-lag gap has no section, theorem, equation, or quoted open-problem anchor in its cited comparators.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2
novelty_flags.one_line: Its frontier claim is compared only with two broad Hawkes-inference threads and omits the closest binned-Hawkes estimation literature and nonregular confidence-set literature.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2
novelty_flags.one_line: The asserted absence of honest boundary inference is not anchored to a located limitation or open problem in a named source.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (simultaneous graph coverage)
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted uniform limit P{G(A)∈C_n(1-α)}→1-α fails under the proposal's beta-min class: for a complete acyclic graph every true sign is separated from zero, so the interval sign code contains G(A) with probability tending to one; with null pairs, membership instead depends only on coverage of those zero coordinates, not the full Gaussian maximum.

source_verification_receipts.version: Stochastic Processes and their Applications 126 (2016), open-access publication PDF
source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF pages 9–10, Theorem 2 and equation (21); PDF page 13, equation (29)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 constructs an INAR(infinity)-based family of point processes converging weakly to a Hawkes process as Δ tends to zero; equation (29) describes its bin-count sequence as an approximation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF page 3, Proposition 2, Theorem 1, and Corollary 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives a causal Wiener–Hopf equation from complete second-order functions and states that first- plus second-order statistics uniquely define the stationary multivariate Hawkes process.

source_verification_receipts.version: Published Entropy 27(6):555 PMC rendering; publisher PDF was not inspectable in this review environment
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The displayed derivation gives the coarse-grained spectral density as the Hawkes spectral density times Δt plus O(Δt^3) in the Δt→0 limit; it is an approximation result, not a finite-lag inverse.
The paper studies fixed-width count observations and states consistency and asymptotic normality for Whittle estimation under a moment condition.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article develops BH-EM parameter estimation for binned Hawkes data and contrasts it with INAR and binned-likelihood approximations.

The paper concerns latent-subprocess Hawkes causal discovery via a discrete-time representation as the time interval shrinks; the inspected material does not state an exact fixed-positive-bin two-lag recovery theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Theorem 4's equality with the valid simultaneous-sign lower-coverage statement, and separately prove uniform support recovery for the thresholded estimator Ghat; do not claim confidence-set membership converges exactly to 1-α on the beta-min class.
For each open-ended question, add three located prior-art comparators and state precisely which theorem, assumption, or limitation leaves the one-lag or boundary-adaptation target unresolved.
Give a nondegenerate explicit one-lag fiber family, or narrow OEQ 1 to a specified three-node support and prove that family is legal before claiming a generic minimality frontier.
Add a formal comparison to ShlomovichCohenAdamsPatel2022 and JinHuang2026, explicitly distinguishing their latent-time or vanishing-bin regimes from exact fixed-positive-bin covariance recovery.

recommended_next_step: Repair the invalid coverage sanity reduction and substantiate both open-question literature frontiers before resubmitting the proposal for novelty review.
